systems.tiers: data offices at central and subnational level (study sites, November 2022 to July 2024)

note: Abstract only. The IMPULSE study observed DHIS2 in central and subnational data offices: facility annual summary reports could be generated in all, and the share of reports received against expected could be calculated in 88.9% of Tanzania's assessed offices. It states nothing on which facility tiers use it, where data is keyed or clinic coverage, so no aspect value is supported.
